name: Daemonic Fog
disable: DC 28 Survival check (expert) to disrupt the fog before the hazard triggers or Dispel Magic (5th rank; counteract DC 26) to counteract the magic.
reset: The hazard resets over the course of an hour as the daemonic stain reenergizes the fog.

items.name: Gnawing Fog
items.text:
Trigger A creature crosses the cavern's midpoint (the dotted line on the map)

---

Effect The hazard deals 9d6 piercing damage (DC 32 basic Reflex save save) to the triggering creature and all other non-fiend creatures within 20 feet. A creature that critically fails the saving throw is Confused for 1d4 rounds.

text: The fog solidifies into tiny, gnawing creatures that devour everyone within before fading back into mist.
